item.title: Philadelphia schools eliminate half days, guarantee bathroom breaks
item.description: The Philadelphia Board of Education voted on Thursday to eliminate half days and codify students' access to bathroom breaks.

item.title: Tennessee AG won’t intervene for Knox County school board in religious charter lawsuit
item.description: An ongoing lawsuit against the Knox County Board of Education could have implications for Tennessee's longstanding public charter school policy, which currently bans religiously affiliated schools.

item.title: How often do kids bring guns to school? Here’s what we know.
item.description: Community members march in a peace walk for National Youth Violence Prevention Week in Indianapolis in 2024.

item.title: NYC students clock about 130 fewer hours in class than national peers. It likely hurts learning.
item.description: Despite a high per-pupil budget, New York City students spend significantly less time in class than the national average. Experts warn less instructional time can hinder learning in the long run.

item.title: Newark teen coalition pushes back after city school board shuts down student policy proposals
item.description: The Newark Board of Education meeting on Thurs., Feb. 26 at Sir Isaac Newton Elementary School.

item.title: U.S. Department of Education releases vision for reshaping federal research after DOGE cuts
item.description: Students inside a classroom at Cody High School during the first day of school on Aug. 25, 2025 in Detroit, Michigan. A new report calls for reimagining the federal government's education research arm to be more useful to educators and policymakers.

item.title: Social media restrictions, cellphone bans, more: what lawmakers passed in the 2026 legislative session
item.description: The 2026 legislative session ended Friday evening with a flurry of activity, including the passage of a number of bills that will reshape Indiana schools.

item.title: These co-ops are meant to support school districts. This one started Colorado’s ‘first public Christian school.’
item.description: Some Colorado lawmakers and education officials worry the controversial creation of a “public Christian school” by a public education cooperative sets a dangerous precedent.

item.title: Should students spend less time testing? Some Colorado lawmakers want a statewide review.
item.description: Some Colorado lawmakers want to see the state cut standardized testing time for younger students, especially because high school students spend less time on exams.

item.title: FBI raids Los Angeles Superintendent Alberto Carvalho’s home, offices: what we know so far
item.description: Los Angeles Superintendent Alberto Carvalho speaks at a press conference in October about how the district is supporting students and families during the federal government shutdown. The FBI raided Carvalho's home and offices Wednesday.
